values.meaning: stacks generated on nearby champion/epic monster death
values.quote: He generates 7 stacks if a nearby enemy champion or epic monster dies.

mechanics.claim: Alistar heals himself and allies simultaneously when the passive triggers.
mechanics.quote: Healing occurs simultaneously for '''Alistar''' and his allies.

mechanics.claim: The heal is on a cooldown separate from stack generation; stacks can build even while the heal is unavailable.
mechanics.quote: ''Triumphant Roar'' can occur only once every few seconds, though '''Alistar''' may still generate stacks before then.

mechanics.claim: If Alistar reaches 7 stacks while the heal is on cooldown, it fires automatically once the cooldown ends.
mechanics.quote: If '''Alistar''' is at 7 stacks when ''Triumphant Roar'' comes off cooldown, he will roar as soon as it elapses.

mechanics.claim: Stacks are lost entirely if Alistar dies.
Stacks are generated for stunning or displacing enemy champions, or nearby minion/monster deaths, not just from the heal trigger.
mechanics.quote: generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Triumph'' for each enemy {{tip|champion}} he {{tip|stuns}} or {{tip|airborne|displaces}} with his {{tip|abilities}}, and each time a nearby enemy {{tip|minion}} or non-epic {{tip|monster}} dies
